# 1 Clement Chapter 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 50 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_050_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 50

**50:1** How blessed and wonderful, beloved, are the gifts of God!

**50:2** Life in immortality, splendor in righteousness, truth in boldness of speech, faith in confidence, self-control in holiness — and all these things fall under our understanding.

**50:3** What then are the things prepared for those who wait for him? The Creator and Father of the ages, the All-Holy One himself knows their greatness and beauty.

**50:4** Let us therefore strive to be found among the number of those who wait for him, that we may partake of the promised gifts.

**50:5** And how is this? Beloved, if our mind is fixed faithfully on God; if we seek the things that are well-pleasing and acceptable to him; if we accomplish the things that are in agreement with his blameless will; and if we follow the way of truth, casting from ourselves all unrighteousness and wickedness, covetousness, strife, malice and deceit, whispering and evil-speaking, hatred of God, pride and boasting, vainglory and inhospitality.

**50:6** For those who do these things are hateful to God; and not only those who do them, but those also who take pleasure in them.

**50:7** For the Scripture says: "But to the wicked God said: Why do you declare my statutes and take up my covenant in your mouth?

**50:8** But you hated instruction and cast my words behind you. If you saw a thief, you ran with him; and with adulterers you set your portion.

**50:9** Your mouth multiplied evil, and your tongue devised deceit. You sat and spoke against your brother; against your mother's son you spread slander.

**50:10** These things you did and I was silent; you imagined, lawless one, that I would be like yourself. I will convict you and set your case before your face.

**50:11** Understand these things, you who forget God, lest he seize you like a lion and there be no one to deliver you.

**50:12** The sacrifice of praise will glorify me; and there is the way in which I will show him the salvation of God."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
